## Why This Is Asked

This tests CGO memory ownership, safe streaming boundaries, and concurrent processing of stateful C resources from Go.

## Key Concepts

- Go-C memory ownership and free_token contract
- Opaque C handles lifecycles
- Streaming parsers: chunked input, token boundaries
- Concurrency: multi-stream worker pool, channel piping
- Error propagation across boundaries and resource cleanup
- Testing: race, partial token, cancellation

```c
void free_token(char* token);
```
